note: Sampling values carry their origin. official_model_card means the vendor published it; backend_model_config means the backend-packaged configuration declared it; backend_default means nothing set it and the backend decides. A run reporting a value without its origin cannot be compared with another run. Context defaults carry context_source: hardware_calibration means the value was set from a ladder measured on this machine, with every tier verified fully GPU resident. Product requirement: this agent targets large repositories, so a deployment that cannot serve 262144 tokens does not qualify for the use case regardless of how it scores. Deployments that can are allocated the full ceiling by default; throughput cost is accepted, because a faster model that cannot see the repository is not useful here.

profiles.provenance: Added 2026-10-14 for the Gemma 4 line (16 GB: 12B; 24-32 GB: 26B-A4B; 64 GB+: 31B). Sampling is Google's for all use cases, the same as the pack's generation_config.json. Reasoning off, as every Gemma run so far measured it; the engine then writes the empty thought block Google advises after a tool result. Whether thinking on serves the agent better is open and measured separately. Context: the trained 262,144, required on every tier (owner's decision 2026-10-14); the window a run gets is computed per host, and the minimum is only the floor a smaller host may fall back to.
